activities.name: Poison Cups
activities.rule: Five cups. One is poisoned. Tap one and drink.

activities.name: Bomb Wires
activities.rule: Five wires. One sets it off. Swipe across a wire to cut it.

activities.name: Glass Bridge
activities.rule: Five panes, one cracked. Hold to aim, release to jump.

activities.name: Stop the Needle
activities.rule: A hidden red zone covers 20% of the dial. Stop the needle outside it.

activities.name: Draw Straws
activities.rule: Five straws, one short. Drag one up to pull it.

activities.name: Five Keys
activities.rule: Five keys. One trips the alarm. Drag a key into the lock.

activities.name: Spin the Wheel
activities.rule: A hidden 20% of the wheel is deadly. Flick it to spin.

activities.name: Elevator
activities.rule: Five floors. One is on fire. Press and hold a button to go.
